summary: iter-202 Admin Repair Ledger — backend (6/6 pytest) and frontend UI (all data-testids, filters, drawer, empty state, mobile, ProtectedRoute) all pass. Registry image deploy static checks were not re-run (out of scope per task note).
action_items: Note (non-blocking): existing /app/backend/tests/test_iter202_repair_ledger.py fails locally with 'future belongs to different loop' when the module-scope `seeded` fixture uses conftest.run_async on the shared loop. It passes in the main-agent's harness but errors under a bare `pytest test_iter202_repair_ledger.py` invocation. The new sibling `test_iter202_repair_ledger_live.py` avoids this by using its own motor client via asyncio.run and is stable — recommend keeping both or having the old one adopt the same pattern.
